reason: I only need full-site screenshots now and then, and my browser extension plus the free 15-page tier covers most of my small client sites. I'd try the free plan, but I'm not adding another subscription on my income for something I do a few times a year.
objection: It's a nice-to-have, not a must-have. The change alerts don't interest me because tools like this are always noisy with false positives, so I'd really just be paying for batch screenshots I can already do by hand.
would_change_my_mind: Landing a big client site with 50+ pages where I need every page on mobile and desktop for a before/after. Then I'd pay $9 for one month and cancel.
